name: Orbital superiority
description: A gameplay change (off by default; set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page). During a ground invasion it matters who holds the orbit above the planet (the armed ships and bases of each side within 2000 of it, the original game's Space Control measure). Attackers clearly stronger: their Space Control bonus is +50% instead of +25%. Contested: the invaders get no bonus, -35% attack rising to -50% the longer it lasts, and lose a little strength every day (supply lines disrupted). Defenders clearly stronger: invaders -50% attack, heavier daily losses and no further landings there (supply lines cut). AI empires weigh it: they invade where they can hold the orbit, keep their fleet over the planet, keep their troops aboard until the orbit is theirs, send relief fleets to their invaded colonies, and pull back from fights they cannot win.

params.name: orbitalSuperiorityRatio
params.label: A side holds the orbit when its space strength is at least this many times the other's

params.name: orbitalSuperiorityAttackerBonus
params.label: Invaders' attack bonus while they hold the orbit (stock Space Control: 0.25)

params.name: orbitalContestedPenaltyStart
params.label: Contested orbit: invaders' attack penalty at first

params.name: orbitalContestedPenaltyMax
params.label: Contested orbit: invaders' attack penalty at the end of the ramp

params.name: orbitalContestedRampDays
params.label: Contested orbit: days of continuous contest for the penalty to reach its maximum

params.name: orbitalContestedAttritionPct
params.label: Contested orbit: invaders lose this % of their strength per day

params.name: orbitalCutPenalty
params.label: Defenders hold the orbit: invaders' attack penalty

params.name: orbitalCutAttritionPct
params.label: Defenders hold the orbit: invaders lose this % of their strength per day

params.name: orbitalAttritionMinReadiness
params.label: An invading unit worn below this readiness (of 100) is lost

params.name: orbitalAiParityRatio
params.label: AI: invades when its fleet plus the fleets it can gather reach this many times the defenders' armed strength in orbit

params.name: orbitalAiLandRatio
params.label: AI: in a contested orbit, its troops land once its strength there is this many times the defenders'

params.name: orbitalAiCooldownDays
params.label: AI: days before it targets a colony again after withdrawing from it

params.name: orbitalAiReliefFleets
params.label: AI: send relief fleets to invaded colonies (1 = yes, 0 = no)

params.name: orbitalAiReliefRange
params.label: AI: fleets within this distance are sent to relieve an invaded colony or reinforce an invasion

params.name: orbitalAiReliefMinRatio
params.label: AI: a relief fleet needs at least this share of the attackers' space strength

params.name: orbitalAiHoldDays
params.label: AI: days invasion troops wait aboard for the orbit before the fleet withdraws

params.name: orbitalAiLosingDays
params.label: AI: days between the invader's reviews of a stalled orbit fight (it sends more fleets; withdraws only when parity is out of reach)
